name: morrow
description: Morrow - Event-Driven Investment OS (research and Paper only)

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build -w @morrow/web
scripts.test: npm run build:server && npm run build:test -w @morrow/web && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test "packages/*/dist/**/*.test.js" "apps/runtime/dist/**/*.test.js" "apps/runtime/dist/**/*.dbtest.js" "apps/web/dist-test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:server && npm run build:test -w @morrow/web && node --test "packages/*/dist/**/*.test.js" "apps/runtime/dist/**/*.test.js" "apps/web/dist-test/**/*.test.js"
